description_en: Queries the certificates associated with a listener
description_zh: 调用ListListenerCertificates接口查询监听绑定的证书列表
kebab_example: aliyun ga list-listener-certificates --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --listener-id lsr-bp1bpn0kn908w4nbw0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListListenerCertificates

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Global Accelerator instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Global Accelerator instance
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en:
The role of the certificate. Valid values:
default: The default certificate.
additional: The additional certificate.

If you do not specify this parameter, both default and additional certificates are returned in the certificate list
parameters.help_zh:
证书的角色。取值：
default：默认证书。
additional：扩展证书。

不传入值时，默认证书和扩展证书都将返回在证书列表中
parameters.name: role

parameters.help_en:
The token for the next query. Valid values:
If this is the first query or no next query is required, you do not need to specify this parameter.
If a next query is required, set the value to the NextToken value returned from the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return for a single request. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
本次读取的最大数据记录数量。
取值范围：1~50，默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

Domain.description_en:
The domain name associated with the additional certificate.

This field is not returned for the default certificate
Domain.description_zh:
扩展证书绑定的域名。

默认证书不返回该字段

IsDefault.description_en:
Indicates whether the certificate is the default certificate. Valid values:
true: The certificate is the default certificate.
false: The certificate is an additional certificate
IsDefault.description_zh:
是否为默认证书。
true：默认证书。
false：扩展证书

State.description_en:
The status of the certificate. Valid values:
active: The certificate is associated with the listener and takes effect.
updating: The additional certificate is being replaced
State.description_zh:
证书的状态。
active：证书绑定监听并生效。
updating：扩展证书替换中

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned for a single request
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次读取的最大数据记录数量

NextToken.description_en:
The token for the next query. Valid values:
If NextToken is empty, no subsequent query is available.
If NextToken is returned, the value is the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
